entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I bought some shoes, and I think I need to return them. I'm just so confused by the whole process on your website.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, I'm not sure. I guess preference? I tried putting the cleats on and they just felt... weird. I'm worried they're going to give me blisters if I actually ride in them. I just don't think they're right for me. Can't you just help me? I'd really just like a refund.
I completely understand. Getting the right fit and feel is the most important thing. Let me just pull up your order information. One moment.
Okay, I see the order here. It looks like they were delivered about 44 days ago. Let me just check our current policy.
Is that bad? 44 days? I wasn't sure what the rule was.
Not at all. You're well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I was stuck with them. The website was a bit overwhelming.

No problem, that's what I'm here for. I've initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just pack the shoes back in the box, attach the label, and you can drop them at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Wow, that was easy. Thank you so much, Isaac. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
Great. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
